strings.command.help:
Toggles the mount collection window.
/mountbook config - Opens the settings window.
/mountbook status - Prints how many mounts you have collected.
/mountbook missing - Prints how many mounts you are still missing.
/mountbook wanted - Prints how many mounts are on your wanted list.
/mountbook recent - Lists the mounts you collected in the last two weeks.
